tmReference: TM 9-6115-641-10, WP 0009, Engine symptoms (engine fails to crank through engine knocks)

options.label: Starts but stops when MASTER SWITCH is released from START

m802e-c1.text: Is the DEAD CRANK switch in the NORMAL position?

m802e-c1a.text: Place DEAD CRANK switch in NORMAL
m802e-c1a.actionText: Place the DEAD CRANK switch in the NORMAL position, then try to crank the engine again.

m802e-c1by.text: Engine fails to crank — DEAD CRANK switch placed in NORMAL. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — DEAD CRANK switch placed in NORMAL

m802e-c2.text: Is the DC CONTROL POWER circuit breaker energized (in)?

options.label: No — de-energized (out); TM: go to next check

m802e-c3.text: Is the Emergency Stop Switch out (not pushed in)?

m802e-c3a.actionText: Reset the Emergency Stop Switch to Normal, then try to crank the engine again.

m802e-c3by.text: Engine fails to crank — Emergency Stop Switch reset to Normal. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — Emergency Stop Switch reset to Normal

m802e-c4.text: Defect in engine starting/electrical system: check the battery connections. Are they loose or corroded?

m802e-c4t.text: Battery connections are loose or corroded. Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — battery connections loose/corroded

m802e-c5t.text: Engine still fails to crank. Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — not corrected by operator checks (check DC CONTROL POWER breaker status)

m802e-s1a.actionText: Turn the MASTER SWITCH to PREHEAT for a maximum of 30 seconds prior to cranking the engine (WP 0005, Starting Procedure). Do not crank more than fifteen seconds; allow the starter to cool at least fifteen seconds between attempts.

m802e-s1by.text: Cold start — engine started after PREHEAT. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Cold start — engine started after PREHEAT

m802e-s2.text: Is the air cleaner element dirty (restriction indicator shows clogged)?

m802e-s2a.actionText: Shut down the generator set. Service the air cleaner assembly (WP 0012, Service of Air Cleaner Assembly): open the left side engine access door, loosen the loop clamp, remove the cup assembly, wing nut and air cleaner element; discard the element if fouled; wipe the canister interior; install the element, wing nut and cup assembly, and tighten the loop clamp.

m802e-s2by.text: Engine would not start — air cleaner serviced, engine starts. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine would not start — air cleaner serviced, engine starts

m802e-s3.text: Is the fuel filter/water separator dirty (water or contaminants in the bowl)?

m802e-s3a.actionText: Service the fuel filter/water separator (WP 0012, Service of Fuel Filter/Water Separator): with the set shut down, rotate MASTER SWITCH to PRIME & RUN, open the left side engine access door, open the drain cock and drain contaminants into a suitable container, close the drain cock and the door, and rotate MASTER SWITCH to OFF.

m802e-s3y.text: Fuel filter/water separator serviced; engine starts.

terminal.summary: Engine would not start — fuel filter/water separator drained, engine starts

m802e-s3n.text: Engine still fails to start after servicing the fuel filter/water separator. Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine cranks but fails to start — needs next higher maintenance

m802e-s4t.text: Engine cranks but still fails to start. Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine cranks but fails to start — not corrected by operator checks

m802e-m1.text: Was the MASTER SWITCH held in START until oil pressure reached 25 psi (172 kPa)?

m802e-m1a.actionText: Hold the MASTER SWITCH in START until oil pressure reaches at least 25 psi (172 kPa) (WP 0005, Starting Procedure), then release it to PRIME & RUN.

m802e-m1b.text: Does the engine keep running now?

m802e-m1by.text: Engine stopped on release of MASTER SWITCH — proper starting procedure used. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine stopped on release of MASTER SWITCH — proper starting procedure used

m802e-m2.text: Are any FAULT INDICATOR lights lit?

m802e-m2a.text: Check and service the fuel tank
m802e-m2a.actionText: Inspect the fuel tank (WP 0012, Inspection of Fuel Tank): check the FUEL LEVEL indicator and that the fuel cap strainer is free of dirt. Service the fuel tank with the correct diesel fuel (WP 0012, Service of Fuel Tank, Table 2). Maintain metal-to-metal contact between the filler nozzle and the tank opening.

m802e-m2b.text: Does the engine start and keep running now?

m802e-m2y.text: Generator set was out of fuel. Fuel tank serviced; engine runs.

terminal.summary: NO FUEL — fuel tank serviced, engine runs

m802e-m2n.text: Engine still stops after the fuel tank was serviced. Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine stops — not corrected after servicing fuel tank

m802e-m2t.text: A fault indicator light other than NO FUEL is lit. Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine stops when MASTER SWITCH released — fault light lit (not NO FUEL)

m802e-m3t.text: Engine still stops when the MASTER SWITCH is released. Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine stops when MASTER SWITCH released — not corrected by operator checks

m802e-x1.text: Are any FAULT INDICATOR lights lit?

options.label: Another fault light is lit (TM: go to next check)

m802e-x1a.text: Check and service the fuel tank
m802e-x1a.actionText: Inspect the fuel tank (WP 0012, Inspection of Fuel Tank) and service it with the correct diesel fuel (WP 0012, Service of Fuel Tank, Table 2). Maintain metal-to-metal contact between the filler nozzle and the tank opening.

m802e-x1b.text: Does the engine start and keep running now?

m802e-x1by.text: Engine stopped suddenly — out of fuel, tank serviced. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine stopped suddenly — out of fuel, tank serviced

m802e-x2.text: Is the DC CONTROL POWER circuit breaker energized (in)?

m802e-x2t.text: DC CONTROL POWER circuit breaker is de-energized (out). Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine stopped suddenly — DC CONTROL POWER breaker out

m802e-x3t.text: Engine stopped suddenly and the cause was not found. Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine stopped suddenly — not corrected by operator checks

m802e-r1.text: Work through the checks in TM order
m802e-r1.actionText: Perform the checks in the order listed in WP 0009.

m802e-ra.text: Is the air cleaner element dirty (restriction indicator shows clogged)?

m802e-ra1.actionText: Shut down the generator set and service the air cleaner assembly (WP 0012, Service of Air Cleaner Assembly). Discard the element if fouled.

m802e-ra2.text: Restart the set. Is the malfunction corrected?

m802e-ra2y.text: Engine runs erratically/misfires — air cleaner serviced. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine runs erratically/misfires — air cleaner serviced

m802e-rf.text: Is contaminated fuel suspected (water/sediment in the fuel filter/water separator)?

m802e-rf1.actionText: Service the fuel filter/water separator (WP 0012, Service of Fuel Filter/Water Separator): drain contaminants into a suitable container through the drain cock.

m802e-rf2.text: Restart the set. Is the malfunction corrected?

m802e-rf2y.text: Engine runs erratically/misfires — fuel filter/water separator serviced. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine runs erratically/misfires — fuel filter/water separator serviced

m802e-ri.text: Is improper type of fuel suspected? (Compare with WP 0012, Table 2 — Diesel Fuel.)

m802e-rit.text: Improper type of fuel is suspected (WP 0012, Table 2). Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine runs erratically/misfires — improper fuel suspected

m802e-rin.text: Engine runs erratically/misfires: Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine runs erratically/misfires — not corrected by operator checks

m802e-p1.text: Work through the checks in TM order
m802e-p1.actionText: Perform the checks in the order listed in WP 0009.

m802e-pa1.actionText: Shut down the generator set and service the air cleaner assembly (WP 0012, Service of Air Cleaner Assembly). Discard the element if fouled.

m802e-pa2.text: Restart the set. Is the malfunction corrected?

m802e-pa2y.text: Engine lacks power — air cleaner serviced. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine lacks power — air cleaner serviced

m802e-pf.text: Is contaminated fuel suspected (water/sediment in the fuel filter/water separator)?

m802e-pf2.text: Restart the set. Is the malfunction corrected?

m802e-pf2y.text: Engine lacks power — fuel filter/water separator serviced. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine lacks power — fuel filter/water separator serviced

m802e-pe1.actionText: Shut down the set, allow the exhaust to cool, and make sure the exhaust opening is free from obstructions.

m802e-pe2.text: Restart the set. Does the engine develop full power now?

m802e-pe2y.text: Engine lacks power — exhaust obstruction cleared. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine lacks power — exhaust obstruction cleared

m802e-pet.text: No exhaust obstruction found. Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine does not develop full power — needs next higher maintenance

m802e-pi.text: Is improper type of fuel suspected? (Compare with WP 0012, Table 2 — Diesel Fuel.)

m802e-pit.text: Improper type of fuel is suspected (WP 0012, Table 2). Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine lacks power — improper fuel suspected

m802e-pin.text: Engine lacks power: Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine lacks power — not corrected by operator checks

m802e-k1.text: Is the lubrication oil level low?

m802e-k1a.actionText: Shut down the set and add oil to the engine crankcase (WP 0012, Service of Lubrication System; refer to LO 9-6115-641-12 for the correct oil).

m802e-k1b.text: Restart the set. Has the knock stopped?

m802e-k1by.text: Engine knock — low oil, oil added. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Engine knock — low oil, oil added

m802e-k2.text: Are there loose parts or foreign objects in the engine compartment?

m802e-k2t.text: Loose parts or foreign objects found in the engine compartment (outcome not stated in the TM). Do not operate; notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine knocks — loose parts/foreign objects in engine compartment

m802e-ki.text: Is improper type of fuel suspected? (Compare with WP 0012, Table 2 — Diesel Fuel.)

m802e-kit.text: Improper type of fuel is suspected (WP 0012, Table 2). Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine knocks — improper fuel suspected

m802e-kin.text: Engine knocks: Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Engine knocks — not corrected by operator checks

tmReference: TM 9-6115-641-10, WP 0009, Blue or white exhaust smoke; Black exhaust smoke

m802x-q1.text: What color is the exhaust smoke?

m802x-b1t.text: Improper type of fuel is suspected (WP 0012, Table 2). Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Blue or white exhaust smoke — improper fuel suspected

terminal.summary: Blue or white exhaust smoke — not corrected by operator checks

m802x-k1.text: Is improper type of fuel suspected? (Compare with WP 0012, Table 2 — Diesel Fuel.)

terminal.summary: Black exhaust smoke — improper fuel suspected

m802x-k2.text: Is the air cleaner element dirty (restriction indicator shows clogged)?

m802x-k2a.actionText: Shut down the set and service the air cleaner assembly (WP 0012, Service of Air Cleaner Assembly). Discard the element if fouled.

m802x-k2b.text: Restart the set. Has the black smoke cleared?

m802x-k2by.text: Black exhaust smoke — air cleaner serviced. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Black exhaust smoke — air cleaner serviced

m802x-k3.text: Check the ammeter (PERCENT RATED CURRENT) on the control panel (WP 0004, Figure 1), rotating the VM-AM transfer switch through each phase. Is the generator set overloaded (more than rated load in any phase)?

m802x-k3a.actionText: Reduce the load until no phase shows more than rated load on the PERCENT RATED CURRENT meter.

m802x-k3b.text: Were you able to reduce the load, and has the black smoke cleared?

m802x-k3y.text: Generator set was overloaded; load reduced and smoke cleared.

terminal.summary: Black exhaust smoke — overload, load reduced

m802x-k3t.text: Unable to adjust the load / smoke persists. Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Black exhaust smoke — overload not corrected

m802x-k3n.text: Black exhaust smoke: Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Black exhaust smoke — not corrected by operator checks

m802o-q1.text: Low oil pressure (normal is 25-60 psi). Is the lubrication oil level low?

m802o-q1a.actionText: Shut down the set and add oil to the engine crankcase (WP 0012, Service of Lubrication System; refer to LO 9-6115-641-12).

m802o-q1b.text: Restart the set. Is oil pressure normal now?

m802o-q1by.text: Low oil pressure — low oil level, oil added. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Low oil pressure — low oil level, oil added

m802o-q2.text: Is the coolant temperature high — above 200 °F (93 °C) on COOLANT TEMP (WP 0004, Figure 1)?

m802o-q2n.text: Oil pressure is low with normal oil level and normal coolant temperature (outcome not stated in the TM). Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Low oil pressure — cause not found by operator

m802o-q3.text: Check the coolant level in the coolant recovery (overflow) bottle. Is it low?

m802o-q3a.actionText: Shut down the set and allow it to cool. Fill the coolant recovery (overflow) bottle to the HOT line if the coolant is hot or the COLD line if it is cold, with the proper coolant/antifreeze (WP 0012, Service of Cooling System, Table 1).

m802o-q3b.text: Restart the set. Is the malfunction corrected?

m802o-q3by.text: Low oil pressure — low coolant, coolant added. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Low oil pressure — low coolant, coolant added

m802o-q4b.text: Restart the set. Is the malfunction corrected?

m802o-q4by.text: Low oil pressure — air intake obstruction removed. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Low oil pressure — air intake obstruction removed

m802o-q5.text: With the set shut down, check the fan belt. Is it loose?

m802o-q5t.text: Fan belt is loose. Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Low oil pressure — loose fan belt

m802o-q5n.text: Low oil pressure: Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Low oil pressure — not corrected by operator checks

m802c-q1.text: Engine overheating (normal COOLANT TEMP is 170-200 °F). Check the ammeter (PERCENT RATED CURRENT), rotating the VM-AM transfer switch through each phase. Is the generator set overloaded?

m802c-q1a.actionText: Reduce the load until no phase shows more than rated load on the PERCENT RATED CURRENT meter.

m802c-q1b.text: Were you able to reduce the load, and is coolant temperature returning to normal?

m802c-q1y.text: Generator set was overloaded; load reduced and temperature returning to normal.

terminal.summary: Overheating — overload, load reduced

m802c-q1t.text: Unable to adjust the load / still overheating. Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: Overheating — overload not corrected

m802c-q2.text: Check the coolant level in the coolant recovery (overflow) bottle. Is it low?

m802c-q2a.actionText: Shut down the set and allow it to cool. Fill the coolant recovery (overflow) bottle to the HOT line if the coolant is hot or the COLD line if it is cold, with the proper coolant/antifreeze (WP 0012, Service of Cooling System, Table 1).

m802c-q2b.text: Restart the set. Is coolant temperature normal now?

m802c-q2by.text: Overheating — low coolant, coolant added. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Overheating — low coolant, coolant added

m802c-q3.text: Is the lubrication oil level low?

m802c-q3a.actionText: Shut down the set and add oil (WP 0012, Service of Lubrication System; refer to LO 9-6115-641-12).

m802c-q3b.text: Restart the set. Is coolant temperature normal now?

m802c-q3by.text: Overheating — low oil, oil added. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Overheating — low oil, oil added

m802c-q4.text: Is there an obstruction in the air intake system?

m802c-q4a.actionText: Shut down the set and remove the debris from the air intake.

m802c-q4b.text: Restart the set. Is coolant temperature normal now?

m802c-q4by.text: Overheating — air intake obstruction removed. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: Low/no battery charge — loose/broken wires

m802l-h1b.text: Restart and operate the set. Is charging normal now?

m802l-i1.text: Test the AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light by depressing it. Does it light?

m802l-i1t.text: AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light fails to light when tested. Refer to next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light failed lamp test

m802l-i2.text: Are the load cables properly connected (WP 0005, Installation of Load Cables)?

m802l-i2a.actionText: Shut down the generator set (never connect or disconnect load cables while it is running) and connect the load cables per WP 0005, Installation of Load Cables. Restart and close the AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER switch.

m802l-i2b.text: Does the AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light come on now?

m802l-i2by.text: AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light — load cables reconnected. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light — load cables reconnected

m802l-i3.text: Does the load exceed the generator rating?

m802l-i3a.actionText: Decrease the load to within the generator set rating.

m802l-i3b.text: Does the AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light come on now?

m802l-i3y.text: Load exceeded the generator rating; load decreased and the light operates.

terminal.summary: AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light — load decreased

m802l-i3n.text: AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER light still fails to light. Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

m802l-i3t.text: Load is correct and the light still fails to light. Refer to next higher maintenance level.

m802l-g1.text: Open the control panel and inspect the circuit breaker on the side of the Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter (GFCI) device. Is it tripped?

m802l-g1a.actionText: Reset the device. On generator sets with contract number DAAK01-88-D-0080, also check the fuse on the black wire of the GFCI.

m802l-g1b.text: Is there voltage at the convenience receptacle now?

m802l-g1by.text: No voltage at convenience receptacle — GFCI breaker reset. Operator corrective action per the TM resolved the malfunction.

terminal.summary: No voltage at convenience receptacle — GFCI breaker reset

m802l-g2.text: Check the Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter indicator. What color is it?

m802l-g2a.actionText: Reset the GFCI by pressing the reset button.

m802l-g2b.text: Is there voltage at the convenience receptacle now?

m802l-g2y.text: GFCI reset; convenience receptacle has voltage.

terminal.summary: No voltage at convenience receptacle — GFCI reset

m802l-g2n.text: Still no voltage at the convenience receptacle. Malfunction is not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009 (General): "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by listed corrective actions, notify your supervisor." Notify next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: No voltage at convenience receptacle — not corrected by operator checks

m802l-g2t.text: GFCI indicator is ORANGE. Refer to next higher maintenance level.

terminal.summary: No voltage at convenience receptacle — GFCI indicator ORANGE

m802l-w1.text: Turn off the heater and attempt restart
m802l-w1.actionText: Before troubleshooting, turn off the heater and attempt a restart. Watch the indicator light near the heater ON-OFF switch and compare its pulses with the Heater Function Codes Plate (WP 0009, Figure 1) on the control panel access door.

m802l-w2.text: After restart, what does the indicator light show?

options.label: Start/glow, normal function (continuous), or purge-and-restart sequence
A malfunction code (any MALFUNCTION sequence on the plate)

m802l-w2y.text: Heater indicator shows an operation sequence after restart (no malfunction code).

terminal.summary: Winterization heater — normal after restart

m802l-w2t.text: Heater indicator light blinks a malfunction code. Per WP 0009: "If you see any of these series of pulses, notify the next-higher level of maintenance." (PMCS item 53: light blinks showing failure — equipment not ready/available.)

terminal.summary: Winterization heater — malfunction code
